from pathlib import Path
from typing import overload
from fastapi import APIRouter
from external_types import ExternalRow as DependencyRow

router = APIRouter(prefix='/api')

class LocalRow:
    key: str

class Repository:
    def __init__(self, root: Path):
        self.root = root

    def read(self, name: str) -> str:
        return self.root.joinpath(name).read_text()

    def write(self, name: str, value: str) -> None:
        self.root.joinpath(name).write_text(value)

    @classmethod
    def from_root(cls, root: Path):
        return cls(root)

    @staticmethod
    def normalize(value: str) -> str:
        return value.strip().lower()

    @property
    def path(self) -> Path:
        return self.root

@router.get('/rows/{name}', response_model=LocalRow)
async def read_row(root: Path, name: str) -> str:
    repository = Repository(root)
    return repository.read(name)

@overload
def normalize(value: str) -> str: ...

def normalize(value):
    return str(value).strip()

def dependency(value: DependencyRow) -> DependencyRow:
    return value

def dynamic_lookup(module_name: str):
    return __import__(module_name)

def report():
    return {'status': 'ready', 'operation': 'read'}
